# How Large Is the ANTISCAM Dataset? A Detailed Assessment of Reported Corpus Size and Annotation Scale

## Executive Summary

The ANTISCAM dataset is a human–human, non-collaborative dialogue corpus built from a role-playing Amazon customer service scam scenario collected on Amazon Mechanical Turk ([Li et al., 2020](https://gitlab.com/ucdavisnlp/antiscam)).
